description: Deep-dive a duplicate-code clone group. Address it either by a source location (file + line) or by a stable fingerprint (fingerprint="dup:<id>" from a find_dupes clone_groups[].fingerprint, usually dup:<8hex> and widened only on rare report collisions). Returns the matched clone instance, every sibling clone group / location, plus per group an extract-function suggestion with estimated line savings and a best-effort suggested_name (the field is omitted, not null, when there is no confident name, so branch on key presence; advisory, verify before applying, never auto-apply). Provide exactly one addressing form. Import declarations are excluded from clone detection by default; pass ignore_imports=false to count them again. Use after find_dupes when consolidating duplication and you need exact sibling locations and a refactor target.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

cross_language.description: Enable cross-language detection (strips TypeScript type annotations for TS/JS matching).

file.description:
Project-relative path to a file containing the clone instance. Used
with `line` to address by source location; omit when using `fingerprint`.

fingerprint.description:
Stable clone-group identity (`dup:<id>`) from a `find_dupes`
`clone_groups[].fingerprint`. Alternative to addressing by `file` plus `line`.

ignore_imports.description:
Exclude import declarations from clone detection. Defaults to `true`
(sorted import blocks are a formatting artifact, not copy-paste); set
`false` to count them again.

ignore_symlinks.description:
Omit clone instances whose path is a symlink or lies under a symlinked
directory. Defaults to the project config; set `false` to report them
even when the config sets `ignoreSymlinks`.

line.description:
Line number of the clone instance within `file`. Used with `file` to
address by source location; omit when using `fingerprint`.

min_lines.description: Minimum line count for a clone. Defaults to the project config, or 5 if unset.

min_occurrences.description:
Minimum number of occurrences before a clone group is reported.
Defaults to the project config, or 2 if unset.

min_tokens.description: Minimum token count for a clone. Defaults to the project config, or 50 if unset.

mode.description:
Detection mode: "strict", "mild", "weak", or "semantic". Defaults to
the project config, or "mild" if unset.

near.description: Detect function-scoped near-miss clones before resolving the trace.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

threshold.description:
Fail if duplication exceeds this percentage. Defaults to the project
config, or 0 if unset. 0 turns the gate off and is not zero tolerance.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: trace_clone
